sources.text:
Our treasury team completed a routine vendor migration after an internal finance review. This is an ordinary administrative update and the commercial relationship is unchanged. Please retain all invoice references and normal deadlines. The new banking arrangements support the same services, and this notice supersedes our earlier payment instructions. Our treasury team completed a routine vendor migration after an internal finance review. This is an ordinary administrative update and the commercial relationship is unchanged. Please retain all invoice references and normal deadlines. The new banking arrangements support the same services, and this notice supersedes our earlier payment instructions. 
Retired IBAN GB46TEST00000000003821 is historical only; do not pay to it.

From: billing@benchmark-vendor.example

Amount: 1250.00
Currency: GBP
Bank: Synthetic New Bank
For this invoice, pay IBAN GB96MOCK00000000009928.
Reason: Our bank reorganized its payment service.
Payment details have changed.
sources.label: PP-09 synthetic email 1

evidence.exact_excerpt: For this invoice, pay IBAN GB96MOCK00000000009928.
For this invoice, pay IBAN GB96MOCK00000000009928.

candidates.value: Our bank reorganized its payment service.

evidence.extracted_value: Our bank reorganized its payment service.
evidence.exact_excerpt: Reason: Our bank reorganized its payment service.

non_destination_spans.exact_excerpt: Retired IBAN GB46TEST00000000003821 is historical only; do not pay to it.

ground_truth.rationale: Only the explicitly current instruction applies; the old identifier is expressly retired. Plausible tone and reasons cannot cancel the change.
